sensor: Thermal: uncooled VOx, 640x512, 17 um pixel pitch, 8-14 um, NETD < 35 mK; optical: 1/1.8in progressive-scan CMOS
features: thermal + optical bi-spectrum stable PTZ for perimeter protection
optical channel: 2 MP (1920x1080), 10 to 780 mm (78x) zoom lens
thermal detector: uncooled VOx, 640x512, 17 um pixel pitch, 8-14 um, NETD < 35 mK
temperature measurement -20 to 150 C, accuracy +/-8 C (3 rule types: 10 points, 10 areas, 1 line)
dynamic fire-point detection (up to 10 fire points) and smoke detection
smart tracking: panorama tracking, event tracking and multi-scene patrol tracking with thermal/optical linkage
perimeter protection algorithm: line crossing, intrusion, region entrance and exit
EIS on thermal and optical channels
NEMA-4X, wiper and heater; TVS 6000V lightning/surge protection
release_notes: The HikMicro HM-TD8167-190ZE2F is a thermal & optical bi-spectrum stable PTZ combining a 640x512 uncooled thermal module with a 2 MP optical zoom channel, temperature measurement (-20 to 150 C), fire/smoke detection and intelligent perimeter protection for long-range security. Verified against the official HikMicro datasheet HM-TD8167-190ZE2F_WYB_Datasheet_en-US_20231123.pdf.

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80). Optical is Channel 1 (101), thermal is Channel 2 (201) - add both channels.
